  • Methodensicherheit, klare Kommunikation und stringente Moderation heterogener Teams

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Reisebereitschaft für Workshops beim Kunden (nach Bedarf)

Benefits

Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung und attraktive Zusatzleistungen

Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

  • Keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma. AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.

Push into generative UI

  • Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

  • Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

  • Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

  • You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

  • You have real taste for layout, typography, interaction and motion, and you care about polish.

  • You are comfortable writing TypeScript and React, including HTML, CSS and animation. You prototype fast and get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days, moving between Figma and code.

  • You have built or extended design systems that others rely on.

  • You already use AI design and coding tools in real work, and you want to help shape new ones.

  • You have 7+ years in product design and front-end engineering on complex products. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you set standards others follow.

What you get:

  • Stock grant opportunities, depending on your role, employment status and location.

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.

  • Optional flexible working office membership with IWG.

About Sine Engineering

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, delivering communication, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our solutions, and our technology powers many of the interceptor operations active today.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. Resilient communication, navigation, and coordination built for the age of autonomy. Our products have already proven their effectiveness in real combat conditions in Ukraine.

Responsibilities

  • Build and expand Sine Engineering's customer and partner network across Germany.

  • Identify, engage, and develop strategic accounts across the defense, aerospace, UAV manufacturing, systems integration, robotics, electronics, telecommunications, RF, autonomy, and other related technology sectors.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including market mapping, prospecting, qualification, discovery, technical evaluation, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and long-term account growth.

  • Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes, technology partners, and relevant government-affiliated stakeholders.

  • Build direct relationships with senior executives and C-level decision-makers while developing strong engagement across engineering, program management, and procurement functions.

  • Position Sine Engineering effectively before formal procurement and tender processes begin.

  • Lead customer discussions related to communication modules, GNSS-denied navigation systems, video links, embedded autonomy software, and integration opportunities.

  • Coordinate technical evaluations, pilot projects, demonstrations, and integration discussions in collaboration with product and engineering teams.

  • Prepare commercial proposals, pricing structures, contract documentation, and partnership models.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, volume commitments, long-term agreements, and commercial frameworks.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM management, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and account planning in line with European business operations.

  • Provide market intelligence regarding German defense procurement, competitors, customer requirements, funding priorities, and partnership opportunities.

  • Represent Sine Engineering at industry events, trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe.

  • Help establish scalable and repeatable sales processes for the German market and contribute to future team growth.

  • Work closely with the Managing Director Germany to ensure commercial account ownership and local market representation remain aligned and complementary.


    Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, strategic account management, or partnerships within a complex technical environment. Experience in the defense, aerospace, UAV, robotics, telecommunications, RF, or deep-tech sectors.

  • Proven track record of managing full-cycle sales processes with enterprise, industrial, defense, aerospace, or technology customers.

  • Strong understanding of long sales cycles, multi-stakeholder procurement processes, and complex commercial negotiations.

  • Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into clear business and technical requirements.

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams.

  • Excellent commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive-level communication abilities.

  • Ability to work independently, proactively creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads.

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scale-up environment.

  • Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, collaborating with both a functional sales manager and a local managing director.

  • Based in Munich or willing to travel there regularly.

  • Willingness to travel frequently across Germany, Ukraine, and Europe.

    Nice to Have

  • Experience building a market presence, territory, or sales function from an early stage.

  • Experience working with international teams, particularly across Germany and Eastern Europe.

  • Experience negotiating framework agreements and other long-term commercial partnerships.


Why Join Us?

If you're excited about building technology that shapes the future of drone autonomy and want your work to have a meaningful impact on defense and security, we'd love to hear from you.

If this role aligns with your experience and ambitions, don't hesitate to apply. We're looking for people who share our drive to push the boundaries of what's possible and deliver technologies that make a real-world difference.

IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)

Krumbach-Niederraunau, Bayern · Hybrid · Vollzeit, unbefristet

Über Everfield

Everfield übernimmt, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Unsere Mission: Ambitionen fördern, Wachstum vorantreiben und Chancen für Europas Software-Ökosystem eröffnen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem arbeiten dezentral: Sie behalten ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte und konzentrieren sich auf das, was sie am besten können – Produkte entwickeln und Kunden betreuen. Everfield unterstützt mit Talent Acquisition, HR und einem Expertenteam, das zu Finanz- und Operations-Themen berät. Seit der Gründung 2022 ist Everfield in neun Ländern vertreten, Tendenz steigend.

Über SoCom

Die SoCom Informationssysteme GmbH entwickelt mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden TIKOS, die führende ERP-Lösung für gewerbliche Wäschereien und Textildienstleister. Mit rund 40 % Marktanteil in der DACH-Region und über 30 Jahren Erfahrung steuern Kunden mit TIKOS ihre gesamte Prozesskette, von der Wäscheannahme über RFID-Tracking bis zur Auslieferung. Seit Oktober 2026 gehört auch die Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH zur SoCom-Familie. SoCom ist Teil des Everfield-Ökosystems.

Über die Rolle

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte IT: die interne Infrastruktur, die Informationssicherheit und die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für unsere Kunden betreiben. Viele dieser Leistungen haben wir bisher extern eingekauft. Jetzt holen wir das Know-how ins Haus – und du stellst die IT so auf, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum, der Integration neuer Unternehmensteile und steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen Schritt hält.

Du bist Gestalter:in und Macher:in zugleich: Du entwickelst die IT-Strategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an.

Deine Aufgaben

• IT-Verantwortung und Strategie: Du verantwortest die IT von SoCom ganzheitlich, entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Roadmap und steuerst das IT-Budget für Hardware, Lizenzen, Cloud und Dienstleister.

• Insourcing und Dienstleistersteuerung: Du überführst bisher extern erbrachte Leistungen – Netzwerk, Firewall, Server, Backup und E-Mail-Security – schrittweise in die eigene Verantwortung. Verbleibende Dienstleister und Verträge steuerst du über klare SLAs.

• Cloud und Hosting: Du betreibst die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für Kunden hosten, und entwickelst sie weiter. Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb und Support kalkulierst du Hosting-Angebote, verantwortest Verfügbarkeit, Kapazität und Kosten und treibst eine zukunftsfähige Hosting-Architektur voran.

• Infrastruktur und Betrieb: Du verantwortest Server, Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und Disaster Recovery – am Standort und in der Cloud – sowie Microsoft 365, Endgeräte, Telefonie und Mobilfunk. Monitoring und Patch-Management steuerst du über ein RMM-Tool.

• Informationssicherheit und Compliance: Als interne:r Owner für IT-Security koordinierst du das Schwachstellen- und Incident-Management, arbeitest eng mit dem CISO-Netzwerk von Everfield zusammen und setzt die Anforderungen aus NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und DSGVO in der Infrastruktur um.

• Integration Düchting: Du bringst die IT der Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH bis 2027 auf SoCom-Standard und konsolidierst Systeme, Lizenzen und Prozesse.

• Dokumentation und Wissenssicherung: Du baust eine belastbare IT-Dokumentation auf – Systeme, Zugänge, Kosten und Notfallpläne –, damit Wissen im Team geteilt und jederzeit verfügbar ist.

• Führung und Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer IT-Administration zusammen und bildest mit ihr ein Team mit gegenseitiger Vertretung. Für Support, R&D, DevOps und Vertrieb bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle IT-Themen.

• KI und Digitalisierung: Du begleitest den sicheren Einsatz von KI-Tools im Unternehmen gemäß der KI-Richtlinie von Everfield und automatisierst interne IT-Prozesse.

Was du mitbringst

Muss

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik o. Ä.) oder Ausbildung zur/zum Fachinformatiker:in mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der IT-Administration oder im IT-Management, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in verantwortlicher Rolle in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen (ca. 30–250 Mitarbeitende)

• Fundierte Praxis mit Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Netzwerken (VLAN, VPN) und Firewalls (z. B. Sophos, Fortinet)

• Erfahrung im Betrieb von Cloud- oder Hosting-Infrastruktur (IaaS, z. B. IONOS, Azure, AWS) inklusive Virtualisierung, Backup und Disaster Recovery

• Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und praktische Erfahrung im Schwachstellen- und Incident-Management

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer IT-Dienstleister sowie im Budget- und Lizenzmanagement

• Hands-on-Mentalität: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und löst Probleme selbst

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse für die Abstimmung im internationalen Everfield-Netzwerk

Kann

• Erfahrung im Hosting von Business-Software für externe Kunden (SLAs, Mandantentrennung)

• Kenntnisse in NIS-2, ISO 27001/BSI IT-Grundschutz oder dem Cyber Resilience Act

• Erfahrung mit SQL-Server-Datenbanken und Linux-Systemen

• Erfahrung mit RMM-Tools (z. B. NinjaOne, Datto RMM) und Automatisierung mit PowerShell

• Erfahrung mit IT-Integrationen nach Unternehmenszukäufen

• Kenntnisse im sicheren Einsatz von KI-Tools

Nicht jede:r erfüllt jeden Punkt. Wenn du die Muss-Kriterien weitgehend mitbringst und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, bewirb dich – wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Bewerbungsprozess

• Erstgespräch (30 Min.) mit Karolina, Talent Acquisition Partner bei Everfield

• Fachinterview (60 Min.) mit Stefan Hoffmann, Geschäftsführer SoCom, und Everfield AI Lead

• Finales Gespräch vor Ort in Krumbach (90 Min.) mit Fallstudie (z. B. ein Insourcing-Plan für einen externen IT-Dienstleister) und Kennenlernen des Teams

Die Position ist hybrid mit regelmäßiger Präsenz an unserem Standort in Krumbach-Niederraunau

data.description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

Key Responsibilities

People, Hiring & Organisation

You will build and shape a high-performing Electronics & Software organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning workforce and headcount planning across the function

  • Recruiting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

  • Developing clear job families, role levels and assessment standards

  • Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering Leads and hiring managers to maintain a high technical hiring bar

  • Leading promotion, compensation and organisational planning within the function

  • Building succession plans and reducing key-person dependencies in specialist areas

  • Creating an organisation that remains lean, scalable and aligned with current and future programme needs

Line Management & Development

Developing strong engineers and technical leaders will be a major part of the role.

You will:

  • Lead and develop the managers, Leads and senior engineers within your organisation

  • Establish meaningful objectives aligned with project and company priorities

  • Build clear development and technical career paths

  • Strengthen mentoring, coaching and leadership capability across the organisation

  • Create opportunities for engineers to gain experience across design, integration, test and operations

  • Address performance challenges fairly and constructively

  • Build a culture where progression is based on demonstrated capability, impact and organisational need

Engineering Processes, Standards & Compliance

You will help define how excellent electronics and software engineering is done across the company.

This includes:

  • Owning and continuously improving engineering practices across electronics, software, GNC and electrical/harness engineering

  • Establishing practical standards for electronics design, software development, testing, modelling, reviews and verification

  • Ensuring teams understand and can effectively apply the relevant processes

  • Supporting certification readiness, audits and continuous improvement, including applicable EN9100 requirements

  • Working closely with Quality, Safety, Systems Engineering and the Chief Engineer organisation

  • Using lessons from development, testing and operations to continuously improve engineering practices

Our aim is not process for process's sake. We want processes that are lean, pragmatic and proportionate to engineering risk.

Engineering Tools & Ways of Working

You will ensure our engineers have the tools and engineering environment needed to work effectively and at scale.

This includes capability across:

  • Electronics and PCB design

  • Harness CAD

  • Software development, build and configuration toolchains

  • Automated testing

  • GNC analysis and modelling

  • Software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments

  • Simulation and shared test infrastructure

You will drive standardisation, adoption and good engineering practice while partnering with Digital, IT, Procurement, Quality and other engineering teams.

The goal is simple: engineering work should be efficient, traceable, reproducible and ready to scale.

Project Support & Resource Planning

You will work closely with our projects to ensure they have access to the Electronics & Software capability they need.

You will:

  • Mentor engineering Leads and provide senior technical guidance where needed

  • Support major technical and engineering reviews

  • Maintain visibility of capability gaps, resource constraints and significant engineering risks

  • Work with project leadership to resolve resource requirements through hiring, development, internal mobility or external support

  • Anticipate future capacity constraints before they become programme blockers

  • Help resolve cross-project resource and organisational conflicts

  • Contribute to the company-wide electronics and software strategy alongside the Chief of Engineering and CTO

  • Shape future capabilities, reusable technologies, R&D priorities and obsolescence strategies

Budget

You will own the Electronics & Software functional budget and forecast, including:

  • Headcount and personnel planning

  • Engineering tools and licences

  • Relevant shared simulation and test capability

  • Training and development

  • Functional team travel

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Digital and project leadership to ensure investment supports both immediate programme needs and longer-term engineering capability.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who combines credible engineering depth with proven organisational leadership.

You should bring:

  • Strong hands-on engineering experience in at least one of the following: avionics, electronics, embedded systems, flight software, GNC or electrical systems

  • Enough technical breadth to operate effectively across several of these disciplines and understand how they interact

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a complex product environment

  • Proven formal line-management experience, including developing managers and technical leaders

  • Experience hiring, developing and building engineering organisations

  • Experience with organisational design, workforce and capacity planning

  • Experience creating or improving engineering processes, tools, standards and ways of working

  • Experience operating within a matrix organisation and supporting multiple projects or programmes

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, communication and influencing skills

  • The technical credibility to challenge senior engineers while empowering the appropriate technical owners to make decisions

  • A pragmatic approach to engineering quality, assurance and compliance, including relevant EN9100 practices

Experience in spacecraft, launch vehicles, aerospace, defence, aviation, robotics or another complex safety-critical engineering environment would be particularly relevant.

We are looking for a leader who:

  • Leads with high standards, humility and low ego

  • Enjoys developing people rather than simply directing them

  • Empowers strong technical Leads and avoids becoming a bottleneck

  • Can challenge experienced engineers constructively

  • Makes decisions using data and sound engineering judgement

  • Balances immediate programme pressures with long-term organisational capability

  • Creates clarity where responsibilities cross organisational boundaries

  • Promotes transparency, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning

  • Believes in extreme ownership and engineering first principles

  • Remains close enough to the engineering to understand the challenges our teams are solving

Location & Travel

This is a leadership role with teams and stakeholders across our European organisation, so regular face-to-face engagement is important.

You should expect to spend time across our main European sites, with additional travel where required for team leadership, recruitment, major engineering reviews, audits and project support.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

We are seeking an experienced and motivated EMC/EMI Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing design recommendations and establishing test policies related to Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) for our spacecraft applications. This role requires a thorough understanding of EMC/EMI principles, spacecraft systems, and industry standards to ensure the reliability and functionality of our spacecraft in harsh space environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design and Development:

    • Provide expert guidance on EMC/EMI design practices to ensure spacecraft systems meet all relevant standards and requirements.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate EMC/EMI considerations into the design phase of spacecraft systems and subsystems.

    • Review and analyze design documents, schematics, and layout plans to identify potential EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Testing and Validation:

    • Develop and implement comprehensive EMC/EMI test plans and procedures for spacecraft systems.

    • Conduct EMC/EMI testing, including pre-compliance and compliance testing.

    • Analyze test data, identify non-conformities, and recommend corrective actions to resolve EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Standards and technological watch:

    • Ensure all designs and test procedures comply with relevant EMC/EMI standards

    • Stay updated with the latest developments in EMC/EMI standards and incorporate them into design and testing processes.

  1. Documentation and Reporting:

    • Prepare detailed technical reports, test summaries, and design documentation related to EMC/EMI activities.

    • Maintain accurate records of all test results, design recommendations, and corrective actions.

  1. Collaboration and Support:

    • Work closely with system engineers, hardware designers, and other stakeholders to address EMC/EMI challenges throughout the product development lifecycle.

    • Provide technical support and training to engineering teams on EMC/EMI best practices and mitigation techniques.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in EMC/EMI engineering, preferably in the aerospace or defense industry.

  • Strong knowledge of EMC/EMI principles, test methods, and mitigation techniques.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

data.description:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

You will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.

What you will do

This role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficiently

  • Challenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titles

  • Co-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech team

  • Own your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learnings

  • Pilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysis

What you bring

  • A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

  • Ownership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructions

  • Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

  • Genuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirement

  • Fluent English (our working language); any additional language is a plus

What we offer

  • Impact: Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.

  • Growth: Take responsibility from day one and develop through regular feedback, workshops, and knowledge exchanges.

  • Personal Development: Use your learning budget and 2 extra study days for conferences, books, courses, and more.

  • Community: Engage with international, diverse, yet like-minded colleagues through regular events and 2 office days per week with your team.

  • Flexibility: Benefit from our hybrid work policy and the chance to work from other local offices for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • Fitness: Get a premium gym membership at a discounted rate.

  • Travel: Enjoy 28 vacation days + 13 public holidays in Bavaria and the possibility to take up to 10 unpaid vacation days with special discounts on our Holidu Homes properties.

Life at Holidu

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram Apply now!
We champion diversity in every aspect of life. We encourage applications from all genders, corners of the world and individual backgrounds. Please feel welcome to submit your application without a photo and details on your gender, date of birth, marital status and nationality. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Als Senior Project Manager BESS /m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland und begleiten diese von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Zur Vertstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten deutschlandweit, die mir ihrer Expertise den Ausbau moderner Energiespeicherlösungen vorantreiben möchten.

  • Erfahrung mit den deutschen Genehmigungsanforderungen (z. B. BImSchG/BImSchV)

  • Unterstützung der Beschaffung sowie Leitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeverfahren

  • Unterstützung während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase

data.description:
Director, Commissioning, EMEA

Role Summary

The Commissioning Director, EMEA will lead commissioning across STACK data centre projects, from early project engagement through testing, validation and final power and facilities handover. This role provides programme-level leadership for the planning, development and consistent execution of commissioning activities across mission-critical facilities, ensuring systems perform safely, reliably and in line with design intent and client requirements.

Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover.

· Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods.

· Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements.

· Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

· Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution.

· Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results.

· Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early.

· Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes.

· Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery.

· Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders.

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps.

· Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities.

What You’ll Bring

· Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes.

· A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems.

· Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles.

· Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings.

· Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements.

· Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance.

· Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners.

· Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%).

What We Offer

· The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA.

· The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business.

· Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. We develop, build and operate Data Centres designed to meet the scale, performance and sustainability requirements of today’s leading technology businesses. Across EMEA, our teams work together to deliver resilient, high-quality infrastructure and create long-term value for our customers and communities.

We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to help build, operate, and secure the infrastructure that supports our rapidly growing company.

This is a broad role an early, hyper scaling startup. You will work across enterprise IT, server administration, hosting, DevOps, user support, and information security. The role combines hands-on technical operations with the opportunity to develop robust, well-managed IT environments for engineering, manufacturing, testing, and business operations.

We are looking for someone who understands that reliable IT is essential to a high-performance engineering organisation and that processes and platforms need to be scalable from initial implementation. You should be comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments, troubleshooting directly, and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Operate and improve IT infrastructure across servers, endpoints, identity systems, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and related services.

  • Manage Windows and Linux systems, including configuration, patching, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

  • Support hosting and DevOps activities, including deployments, automation, system reliability, and operational documentation.

  • Manage user access, permissions, devices, software, and IT support requests across the organisation.

  • Help design and maintain secure, segregated, and reliable IT environments for engineering, operations, and business functions.

  • Support IT processes including incident management, change control, asset management, configuration management, and security compliance.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in IT operations, IT support, systems administration, server management, DevOps, hosting, or a similar technical role.

  • Practical experience administering Microsoft environments, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, or comparable services.

  • Experience managing servers and infrastructure in Windows, Linux, data-centre, or hybrid environments.

  • A strong interest in IT security, system reliability, access control, hardening, monitoring, and structured operations.

  • The ability to troubleshoot methodically, document solutions clearly, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

Desirable experience/Things you will have the opportunity to support

  • BSI-approved cryptography or other regulated information-security requirements.

  • Cloud computing, virtualisation, hypervisors such as Proxmox, virtual machines, Docker, or Kubernetes.

  • Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Ansible or Terraform, together with software-development experience.

  • Enterprise IT tools including mobile-device management, patch management, CMDB, ISMS, monitoring, or hardware and asset-management systems.

Benefits and important information:

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

✏️ What you will do

As Account Executive for Southern Europe, you'll build NetBird's business in France, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece, with France as your anchor market. Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. You own the full cycle, from first touch to signed contract and expansion. You'll report to our Head of Sales and work closely with our Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle in Southern Europe: prospecting, discovery, demos with a Solutions Engineer, proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Turn open source and self-serve users into paying annual customers, using product usage signals to find the right accounts and the right moment.

  • Run outbound into mid-market and enterprise companies that want to replace legacy VPNs such as OpenVPN, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet or GlobalProtect.

  • Sell to technical buyers, from infrastructure and network engineers to security leads, with a clear story on open source, self-hosting and zero trust.

  • Build relationships with MSPs, integrators and resellers across the region.

  • Meet customers on site, at conferences and at meetups, and join the team in Berlin for regular offsites.

  • Keep your forecast and HubSpot data accurate, and bring regional product and pricing feedback back to the team.

  • Shape messaging for French-speaking markets with Marketing, including compliance and data sovereignty topics such as NIS2, GDPR and SecNumCloud.

This is a builder role: you'll be the first person dedicated to the region, with a lot of freedom in how you build it and room to grow as the team expands.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for a French-speaking Account Executive who loves selling technical products and has built a territory from little or nothing. If you've sold commercial open source, developer-led or security products into France and Southern Europe, we'd especially love to hear from you.

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years closing new business as an Account Executive in B2B software, with a track record of hitting quota.

  • Experience selling networking, security, infrastructure or DevOps software, for example VPN, ZTNA or SASE, identity, firewall or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with an open source, product-led or freemium model, and turning free users into paying customers.

  • Comfortable discussing WireGuard, VPN vs. zero trust, SSO and identity provider integration, Kubernetes and self-hosting with engineers.

  • A structured qualification approach such as MEDDPICC.

  • Native French, and able to run discovery, negotiations and executive meetings in French.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Self-directed and organised when working remotely, and happy to travel regularly across the region and to Berlin.

  • You work AI native. You use AI tools every day, for example to research accounts, prepare discovery calls or draft outreach, and you know where they help and where they don't.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Spanish, Italian or Portuguese.

  • Experience as the first or second Account Executive in a new region at a startup.

  • An existing network of IT and security leaders in France, Spain or Italy.

  • Experience with channel partners, MSPs or public sector procurement.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: The region is yours. You build your own pipeline, own your number, and fix what's in the way instead of waiting for it to be fixed.

  • Default to candor: You forecast honestly, call out deals that aren't real early, and tell customers clearly what NetBird does and doesn't do.

  • Stay close to the user: You know our product well enough to have credible conversations with engineers, and you bring what customers say back to the team.

😌 What's in it for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary and equity.

  • Attractive commission plan with no cap on variable pay.

  • Fully remote within the region (+/-1 Central European Time), with regular time with the team in Berlin.

  • Build a region from day one: real ownership of the territory, and room to grow as we expand our sales team.

  • Close collaboration with our Head of Sales, Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, and health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass).

If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other

We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work.

  • Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are.

  • Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base.

 

You might be a fit if

  • You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work.

  • You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product.

  • You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why.

  • You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects

  4. Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

  • You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings.

Bonus points

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Compensation: €60 – €75,000
