One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

  • Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

  • Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

  • Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.






Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

The Process

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

Du hast schon Onlineshops zum Wachsen gebracht und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du auf höchstem Niveau arbeiten kannst? Dann übernimm bei EVOLVE die Conversionrate-Optimierung und Funnelentwicklung von E-Commerce-Brands, von der ersten Analyse bis zum messbaren Ergebnis.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Jedes Jahr verwalten wir über 60 Millionen € Adspend und denken jedes Projekt von der Ad über den Funnel bis zur Marge. Unser Name ist Programm: Wir entwickeln uns, unsere Dienstleistung und unsere Kunden ständig weiter. Das spiegelt sich auch in unserer Mitarbeiterbewertung auf kununu mit 4,8 von 5 Sternen wider.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

Das wirst du tun

Du bist verantwortlich für verkaufsstarke Shopseiten und Funnels, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kunden den Markt outperformen.

  • Analyse: Du analysierst Shops, Landingpages und Funnels ganzheitlich und leitest daraus priorisierte Hypothesen und Maßnahmen ab

  • Positionierung: Du deckst die entscheidenden Hebel in der Customer Journey auf und entwickelst Positionierungen, die Marken klar vom Wettbewerb abheben

  • Konzeption: Du erstellst conversionstarke Shop- und Landingpage-Konzepte und steuerst die Umsetzung mit UX-Design und Copywriting

  • Kunden und Projekte: Du führst Kunden eigenständig durch den Optimierungsprozess und verantwortest Projekte bis zum messbaren Ergebnis

  • Trends: Du verfolgst die aktuellsten Trends im Brand- und Direct-Response-Marketing und bringst sie in unsere Methodik und Standards ein

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte, stehst damit aber nicht allein: Unsere Experten für UX-Design, Copywriting und Performance Marketing setzen deine Konzepte mit dir um. Dich erwartet ein Team, das für Ergebnisse, Verlässlichkeit und kreative Exzellenz steht, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Feedbackkultur.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, E-Commerce oder UX, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Shop mit relevantem Traffic

  • Sicherer Umgang mit GA4, Hotjar/Clarity und A/B-Tests

  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Positionierung, Customer Journey und Conversion-Psychologie

  • Klare Kommunikation, schriftlich wie im Kundengespräch

  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit: Du priorisierst konsequent und gibst klare Empfehlungen

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • Vollzeit mit einer 38-Stunden-Woche

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, JobRad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

Vielleicht fragst du dich gerade …

„Wie viele Projekte betreue ich parallel?“ Wenige, dafür aber in der Tiefe. So kannst du dich wirklich in jede Marke reindenken. Du arbeitest nicht am Fließband, sondern begleitest deine Kunden langfristig und siehst, was aus deinen Konzepten wird.

„Welche Rolle spielt AI bei euch?“ Eine große. ChatGPT und Claude werden deine besten Freunde, denn mit den modernsten AI-Workflows optimierst du deine Arbeit und das Ergebnis für deine Kunden. Dafür hast du vollen Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack. So bleibt mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt: die richtigen Ideen für deine Kunden.

„100 % Remote, verliere ich da den Austausch?“ Nein. Wir sind eine Remote-Agentur, aber Persönlichkeit und Teamspirit bleiben erhalten. Du hast das Gefühl eines Office-Teams, nur ohne Lärm und ohne Fahrt ins Büro. Dafür sorgen regelmäßige Projektabstimmungen, unsere wöchentlichen Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR-Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About the Role

At Cognition, partners are force multipliers. Partner Deployed Engineers (Partner DEs) are partner-facing (and customer-facing) technical experts who enable services partners such as Global Systems Integrators to successfully deploy, scale, and deliver value with Devin and Windsurf across their client base.

In this role, you will work closely with partner solution architects, delivery leads, and engineering teams to help them build repeatable offerings and internal expertise on top of the Cognition platform. Rather than owning a single customer, you’ll amplify impact by enabling partners to support many customers at scale.

This role blends deep technical work, partner enablement, and ecosystem thinking. You’ll lead technical enablement sessions, co-deliver pilots, unblock complex deployments, and help GSIs operationalize Devin/Windsurf into their delivery motions. You’ll act as Cognition’s technical representative within partner organizations.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the technical success of GSI partners across onboarding, enablement, and scaled delivery of Devin/Windsurf

  • Work directly with partner engineering and architecture teams to understand their delivery models, tooling, and customer use cases

  • Enable partners to build repeatable solutions, accelerators, and reference architectures using Devin/Windsurf

  • Lead technical trainings, workshops, and deep dives for partner teams (hands-on, not slideware)

  • Support partner-led customer pilots and early production deployments, stepping in where complexity is highest

  • Act as a technical escalation point for complex integrations, security reviews, CI/CD environments, and enterprise workflows

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with partner technical leaders in GSIs (e.g., delivery heads, principal engineers, solution architects)

  • Capture field learnings and partner feedback to influence product roadmap, packaging, and partner readiness

  • Proactively identify gaps in partner capability and work with internal teams to close them

What We Value

  • Partner expertise. You understand how GSIs operate, deliver projects, and measure success

  • Ownership mindset. You take responsibility for partner outcomes, not just enablement activities

  • Technical depth. You can reason about real systems, not just demos

  • Leverage thinking. You prefer enabling 10 teams over doing the work for 1

  • Bias toward execution. You move quickly from concept to working deployment

  • Comfort with ambiguity. Partner environments are messy; you thrive in that reality

Requirements

You Might Excel If You…

data.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We are looking for an Accounts Payable and Receivable Assistant to keep our day-to-day payables and receivables accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You will own the detail of supplier invoice processing, customer invoicing, and cash allocation, follow our financial controls, and raise blockers early. Your work allows the wider team to move quickly without losing financial discipline.

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with budget owners, procurement, commercial teams, and colleagues across the business who supply approvals and billing information. The role suits someone who takes pride in accuracy, is comfortable working to regular deadlines, and knows when to escalate an issue rather than leave it unresolved.

What You Will Do

  • Process supplier invoices end to end, including checking that they are complete and approved, coding them correctly, and posting them promptly across the entities you support.

  • Raise customer invoices promptly once approved billing inputs are received, and keep billing accurate and well documented.

  • Allocate customer receipts to the correct accounts quickly, and investigate and resolve unidentified payments.

  • Prepare and complete AP and AR reconciliations by the agreed monthly deadline, supporting a clean and timely month-end close.

  • Investigate differences and unusual items, and escalate anything that remains unexplained to the appropriate owner without delay.

  • Keep the approvals and supporting evidence required for every transaction you handle, so that records are complete for internal review and external audit.

  • Review overdue payables and receivables each week, assign an owner and next action to each overdue item, and follow up until it is resolved.

  • Respond to queries from suppliers, customers, and internal colleagues on invoices, payments, and account balances.

  • Follow documented procedures and financial controls, and suggest improvements where you see ways to make processes more accurate or efficient.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience processing accounts payable and accounts receivable, including reconciliations.

  • A high standard of accuracy and close attention to detail, particularly in coding and data entry.

  • A good understanding of financial controls, with sound judgement about what to approve, query, or escalate.

  • Strong prioritisation and follow-through, with the ability to meet recurring deadlines and keep many items moving at once.

  • Clear written and spoken communication, including raising issues promptly and explaining them concisely.

  • Working knowledge of accounting systems and strong spreadsheet skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting month-end close and audit requests.

  • Experience working across multiple legal entities or currencies.

  • Experience in a fast-growing or scaling business.

  • A qualification or part-qualification in accounting or finance.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Chief Engineer, Air to lead the engineering of our Western-facing air platforms and turn operational lessons from Ukraine into reliable, manufacturable products that global customers can test, deploy and reorder.

You’ll own the technical baseline across the air portfolio, initially focusing on Platform N and expanding to other platforms sold outside Ukraine. You’ll work closely with Ukrainian engineering teams to understand the wider Nemesis pipeline, translate field experience into product improvements and build a consistent view of configurations and engineering evidence across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on senior technical leadership role. You’ll stay close to the hardware and the field, build a small engineering team, and bring engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and commercial partners together to deliver products at pace without compromising technical rigor.

The role is based in the UK and involves regular travel to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers. Reporting arrangements and travel expectations will be confirmed during the hiring process.

What you’ll do

  • Own the air portfolio’s technical baseline. Establish controlled requirements, configurations, bills of materials and test evidence, starting with Platform N and extending across Western and Ukrainian air platforms. Put clear ownership and practical change control in place.

  • Lead end-to-end systems engineering. Make and coordinate technical decisions across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces, software interfaces and ground systems, bringing in specialists where needed.

  • Improve reliability and performance. Establish a disciplined failure-reporting and corrective-action process, investigate priority field and test issues, and demonstrate improvements against agreed requirements through repeatable testing.

  • Turn operational lessons into product improvements. Work with Ukrainian engineering and field teams to understand what has worked, capture operator feedback and agree a prioritised design-change roadmap for Western variants.

About us

Infinite Lambda is a data and AI consultancy that helps the world’s leading companies become data-first. We design and build modern, cloud-native data platforms, and we help our clients turn them into real business value with AI.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, and we’re now a global team across three regions. Headquartered in London, we have engineers and consultants in the United States, the UK, France, Italy, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania, Bulgaria, Vietnam and Singapore. We’re also building new teams in Brazil, Argentina and Chile.

Our mission is to bring exceptional people together to make an impact where technology meets sustainable growth. You’ll work alongside experts in dbt, Snowflake and the wider modern data stack on complex, meaningful projects, in a culture built on curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning.

We’re a diverse team, and we want everyone to feel comfortable being themselves at work. If you want to grow fast, learn constantly and help shape where we go next, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

Every enterprise wants to be AI-ready, and most are held back by legacy data estates built over decades. As Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead, you’ll own how Infinite Lambda solves that problem: moving the world’s largest organisations off Informatica, Talend, SSIS/SQL Server, DataStage, stored procedures and, increasingly, SAS and Alteryx, onto modern platforms ready for AI.

Enterprise migrations are a core pillar of our growth strategy, and this role sets the standard for how we deliver them globally. The practice spans the full migration lifecycle:

  • Assess: Estate discovery, feasibility analysis and migration strategy, ending in a fixed-cost, fixed-timeline proposal that gives clients certainty from day one.

  • Convert: Automated code conversion with Flowline, our proprietary product, which combines deterministic and LLM-assisted methods. This stage also covers refactoring, optimisation and a first-pass ontology that lays the foundation for AI use cases.

  • Validate: Reconciliation architecture and row-level sign-off, so every migration is provably correct.

The first part is delivery excellence that compounds. You’ll make sure every migration we deliver is better than the last. That means defining the standards, building the playbooks and reusable assets, and turning the lessons from each strategic engagement into capability across the practice. You’ll also develop the engineers and leads who carry that standard across AMER, EMEA and APAC.

The second part is commercial impact. You’ll turn delivery quality into a competitive edge: faster delivery, sharper scoping and pricing, and healthy margins you can measure and report on. Working closely with Sales and Solution Engineering, you’ll shape the offer that makes Infinite Lambda the obvious choice for enterprise migration, anywhere in the world.

Responsibilities

1. Practice and standards

  • Be the person engineers, sales and clients ask when a migration question is hard: what to migrate first, what to refactor and what to move as is, and how to resolve conflicting logic.

  • Own the migration standard for Assess, Convert and Validate. This covers reference architectures, sequencing, reconciliation and stage-gate checklists, and what we won’t do.

  • Make sure Fast and Deep Discovery produce a defensible estimate, a dependency map and early red flags before we commit to a fixed price.

  • Hold the same quality bar in every region: conversion quality, reconciliation sign-off and post-go-live incidents.

  • Keep the practice up to date as Flowline, the source parsers and the target platforms change (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg).

2. Knowledge, IP and the asset catalogue

  • Join engagements at scoping and agree what each strategic migration should leave behind (patterns, decisions, failure modes, measurements) and who will capture it.

  • Capture lessons at wave checkpoints, and close each engagement with a review of what worked, what didn’t, and what should change in the standard.

  • Decide which lessons become reusable assets and which stay one-offs.

  • Bring field requirements and recurring challanges to the Flowline product team, and move proven assets into Product & Services.

3. People and enablement

  • Build a global bench of migration specialists. Develop engineers across AMER, EMEA and APAC into a team that can deliver migration waves to our standard, independently and at scale.

  • Own the path from practitioner to leader. Design and run the progression that takes engineers from dbt and Snowflake foundations, through Flowline accreditation and deep expertise in a legacy source system, to owning delivery waves and ultimately leading client assessments.

  • Turn what we know into how we work. Make our accelerators and existing assets visible and reusable across every team, so each engagement starts from our best work rather than a blank page.

4. Commercial

  • Make sure live engagements actually use the practice’s accelerators.

  • Help Sales and Sales Engineers scope, estimate and price from measured delivery speed, so the client pays for the acceleration instead of getting it for free.

  • Make the commercial case for the practice in proposals, extensions and new scope. This includes turning Discovery engagements into migrations and expanding into BI and semantic-layer work.

5. Partners and internal work

  • Act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and Fivetran, and feed what we learn in delivery into joint go-to-market, certifications and co-marketing.

  • Write interview material and run technical interviews for migration roles.

  • Present the practice’s work inside the company and, where it makes sense, at external events and in case studies.

Requirements

  • Ownership at a strategic level. You take full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. You’ve owned a practice, a service line or a major programme end to end (its direction, quality, people and commercial results), and you’re comfortable making the calls that shape how a business delivers.

  • Enterprise migration experience at scale. You have a track record of leading large, complex migrations off legacy platforms such as Informatica, Talend, Oracle, SSIS or DataStage, and you know where these programmes tend to go wrong.

  • Depth across both ends of the migration. You have hands-on knowledge of legacy source systems and modern platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg, dbt, Fivetran), plus a structured approach to assessment, conversion and validation.

  • A builder of repeatable delivery. You’ve defined reference architectures, sequencing frameworks and quality gates, and built libraries of reusable assets and accelerators that teams actually use.

  • A multiplier of talent. You’ve developed engineering teams across regions through mentoring, structured skill pathways and accreditation, and you’ve raised the bar for how those teams deliver.

  • Credibility with clients and partners. You can lead discovery sessions with senior client stakeholders, act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with partners such as Snowflake and Databricks, and assess engineering talent in interviews.

  • Commercial awareness. You understand how delivery choices affect scoping, pricing and margin, and you enjoy working with Sales to win the right work.

Line management & how you will be supported

Your line manager is the Chief Customer Success Officer, who is accountable for your direction, the practice charter and the review of your objectives. Strategic direction will be consulted with CTO and Head of Engineering.

Why join Infinite Lambda

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.

Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.

Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai.

The Role:

Stuut is looking for an EMEA Partnerships Lead to build and scale our partnership channels across Europe. This will be the first partnerships hire in EMEA, responsible for developing strategic relationships, creating new revenue opportunities, and building the regional partnerships team.

This person will own three key channels: Private Equity, Consulting & Advisory, and Hyperscaler Marketplaces, with a primary focus on private equity and consulting partnerships.

Responsibilities:

  • Build private equity partnerships: Develop relationships with European PE firmand operating partners to drive introductions and adoption across their portfolio companies.

  • Develop consulting partnerships: Expand Stuut's relationship with EY, build relationships with other Big 4 firms, and establish partnerships with finance transformation boutiques.

  • Drive hyperscaler partnerships: Build relationships with Microsoft seller teams across the UK and EU to generate pipeline through Azure Marketplace. ● Drive revenue: Turn partnerships into measurable pipeline, sourced revenue, and ARR.

  • Develop the EMEA strategy: Create the regional partnerships playbook, prioritize target firms, and establish joint go-to-market programs.

  • Build and lead a team: Hire and manage the EMEA partnerships organization. ● Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Product, and global partnership leaders to accelerate growth.


Experience/Qualifications:

  • 7-10 years of experience in European private equity, investment banking, growth equity, or consulting.

  • Strong relationships across the European private equity ecosystem, particularly with operating partners and value creation teams.

  • Experience in Big 4 consulting, finance transformation, or transaction services is highly relevant.

  • Ability to build strategic partnerships from the ground up and turn them into revenue-generating channels.

  • Strong understanding of finance transformation, working capital, and order-to-cash processes.

  • Experience with technology alliances, consulting partnerships, or hyperscaler marketplace programs is a plus.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently, carry a revenue target, and build a team in a fast-growing startup.

US Compensation

  • Top-of-market salary and equity package

  • Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you

  • 401(k) & Match

  • Equity

  • Flexible PTO

  • Parental Leave

Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.

What is the job?

An exciting opportunity to be part of a fast scaling health tech company that’s redefining how patients access care.

We are looking for an ambitious General Practitioner to join our growing team and help shape the future of personalised medicine.

This is more than a clinical role, it’s an opportunity to combine hands-on patient care with innovation, education, and leadership in one of the UK’s most exciting areas of healthcare.

What will you be doing?

  • Conduct video-based new patient assessments to evaluate medical suitability for treatment working closely with the head of clinical services, independent prescribing pharmacists, nurses and consultants.

  • Take thorough medical histories and apply strong clinical judgment to guide care decisions in a time-efficient manner.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex safeguarding issues and help guide safeguarding processes alongside our governance team.

  • Provide advice for complex clinical queries.

  • Contribute to training and upskilling our clinical teams.

  • Ensure accurate and compliant patient records in line with governance protocols.

  • Provide patients with clear, supportive guidance on next steps in their treatment journey.

  • Collaborate across a multidisciplinary team to deliver safe prescribing pathways.

  • Contribute to the development of innovative patient pathways and clinical processes.

What do you need?

  • GMC-registered GP with license to practice in the UK.

  • At least 5 years’ post-registration experience.

  • Strong diagnostic and decision-making skills.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in digital-first and hybrid environments.

  • A genuine interest in innovation, health tech, and emerging therapies.

  • Excellent communication skills and digital fluency.

  • Experience in telemedicine or digital health (desirable)

  • Background in pain management, neurology, mental health, or complex chronic conditions (desirable).

What we offer:

  • Salary: £100,000 to £110,000 per annum (FTE), based on a 40-hour working week. We are offering flexible working arrangements of either 24 or 32 hours per week. Salary will be calculated on a pro-rata basis according to the agreed contractual hours.

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year two) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £100K – £110K

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Frontu

Frontu is a B2B SaaS Field Service Management (FSM) platform built for the companies that keep the world running - heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, material handling, and mining. Our platform digitises field operations for 7,000+ technicians across 20 countries, plugging directly into existing ERP systems as a powerful mobile layer.

We are part of Everfield, a European private equity group that builds and grows vertical SaaS businesses. Through Everfield, you will be joining a network of 1,000+ professionals across Europe with shared knowledge, resources, and commercial muscle behind you, but at the same time will work with a small 20 person team at Frontu.

We are now expanding into Southern Africa. Frontu is already used by a few companies in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Indian Ocean islands so we need local support in the region.

The Role

This is a hunter role. You will own new business development across Southern Africa. We already have customers in Southern Africa and early traction across the region - proof that the market works. We also come with a mapped prospect database covering the region. What we do not have yet is someone pushing things forward at the pace this opportunity deserves.

This is not a role for someone who needs everything built for them. The foundation is there - customers, data, product. What it needs is someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and turns existing signals into closed deals.

What You Will Do

  • Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and outbound outreach to discovery, demo, proposal, and close

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, referrals, industry events, and partner channels in heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, and material handling verticals

  • Run consultative discovery with your core champions - aftersales directors, service managers, and C-level executives - understand their ERP landscape and position Frontu as the field service layer their technicians are missing

  • Deliver tailored demos and ROI-driven proposals adapted to the buyer context

  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts in CRM (Pipedrive) - we run a tight ship

  • Work closely with Head of Sales on GTM strategy, pricing, and market feedback loops

  • Hand closed accounts to Customer Success

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a track record of owning and closing full-cycle deals

  • Background in SaaS, ERP, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software - you know what a software sales cycle looks like and how to navigate procurement

  • Native or business-level Afrikaans and professional English (written and spoken - both are required)

  • Self-managed and autonomous - you will operate with a 6 - 8 hour time zone difference from the European team; asynchronous discipline is non-negotiable

  • Consultative, senior selling mindset - you influence C-level and operations stakeholders, not just fill out forms

  • CRM proficiency, ideally Pipedrive

  • Comfortable working as an independent contractor

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience selling to or working with companies running Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, SAP, Sage, AutoIT or similar ERP or DMS systems

  • Industry network or experience in Southern Africa heavy industry (agriculture, construction, material handling, or mining)

What We Offer

  • Competitive OTE with 60% base retainer / 40% variable, uncapped commission

  • First-mover position in a high-growth region with genuine ownership over the region

  • Direct access to Head of Sales and a proven European GTM playbook

  • A clear ICP, competitive battlecards, and battle-tested messaging - you will not be starting from zero

  • Flexible, remote-first setup - no micromanagement, outcome-based working model

  • Access to the Everfield network of 1,000+ professionals across Europe

  • A path to leading the region team as the region grows - we are starting small and building deliberately

Process

  • Screening call with TA 30 min

  • Interview with Hiring Manager 60min

  • interview with Hiring Manager and Managing Director 60min

Our team is made up of people with software & technology backgrounds, and others with deep expertise in the end-markets we serve. We all share a common goal, which is to be the number one SaaS solution in the utilities and infrastructure space.

We are a passionate team who genuinely enjoy working together, and it shows in how we operate. We set a high bar because we're proud of what we do, and we know how important it is to our customers and the critical work which they deliver, building and maintaining the UK's infrastructure.

Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement

FTC 14 months

Coach & Instructor Enablement exists to make the delivery organisation measurably better at retaining learners and delivering successful outcomes consistently, predictably and at scale.

You will enhance our existing strategy and lead the team through its exciting next stage of growth. The team will form around four capability pillars and a new Enablement Operations platform. You will be building that structure while it delivers across a large delivery organisation that supports thousands of learners. Priorities will shift underneath you as delivery data moves, and part of the job is deciding what starts, what stops, and most importantly what must not slip.

This is a role for a strong operator who excels at influencing and collaborating across complex teams and departments. A proven track record of getting work done across teams with clear asks, embedding shared measures of success, and creating an environment where there is no ambiguity about who owns what is are the keys to success within this role.

You will lead a team of six specialists supporting hundreds of coaches and instructors across all learner programmes.

What you'll own

  • Delivery Fundamentals: the standard for what good coaching and instruction look like, QA against that standard, calibration in partnership with Delivery and Quality

  • Operational & Regulatory Change: every coach and instructor has the process, tooling and regulatory knowledge to deliver, and gets it before the change reaches a learner.

  • Technical Skills & Programme Requirements: coaches and instructors are current and designated on the technical content they deliver.

  • Timely Assessment & Achievement: shared ownership for timely learner achievement.

  • Enablement Operations & Systems: the foundation underneath all four.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the direction and deliver results.. Define the owner, mandate and measures for each pillar, help prioritise and sequence work, and make trade-offs needed to deliver the greatest business impact.

  • Build Enablement Operations SMEs own skills and requirements while operations gets the enablement to the right people, on time, and tracks who did it.

  • Prioritise and re-prioritise without drama. Run a single visible enablement roadmap, say no clearly, and re-sequence when delivery data, business need or regulatory change demands it.

  • Delivering through other teams. Partner with Learning on programme and content change, Operations on process, Quality on the coaching standard, and Delivery on learner retention and achievement.

  • Close the feedback loop with Delivery Leadership. React to performance trends from monthly calibration, observations and delivery data.

  • Lead and develop six specialists through regular 1:1s, feedback, and clear individual measures.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A proven track record of balancing cross functional relationships and their priorities while still delivering impact in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

  • A demonstrable operator. You have taken something loosely defined and made it run: clear owners, measures, cadence, reporting. You are comfortable in the detail and you finish things.

  • Fluent cross-functionally. You have delivered outcomes that depended almost entirely on teams you did not manage, and you can explain exactly how.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity and shifting priorities. You decide on incomplete information, name the risk you are accepting, and change course without losing momentum or the team's confidence.

  • Data-led. You use performance data to decide where to intervene and to hold others accountable.

  • AI-native operator. You build cadences that use AI to do the collating and chasing, so the process scales with the team rather than growing headcount alongside it.

  • Experience of enablement, L&D, capability building, delivery operations or quality in an at-scale frontline organisation.

  • Apprenticeships, regulated education or another regulated delivery environment is a strong advantage. You can hold quality, compliance and pace at the same time.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write the one-pager a senior leader acts on, and run the calibration session a coach finds useful.

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

The ideal candidate will have 1-3 years of experience as an Account Manager or Renewals Specialist, with a proven ability to foster relationships and expand account spend.

At this time, we're prioritizing folks who live in the UK.

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. The Supercell Recruitment team

ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

About the Role

As our Head of People, you’ll own everything related to our growing workforce (65 people today). Compensation, leveling, performance, org design: most of it exists today and yours, and it’s yours to upgrade to make sure it remains best-in-class as we scale. You’ll lead a lean team across Talent Acquisition and Talent Development (2 people for now), work directly with the CEO and Head of Ops, and have a real say in how ScorePlay scales internationally.

It’s also a rare chance to answer a question most People leaders are only starting to ask: what does a high-performing company look like when AI changes roles, team sizes and what we hire for?

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll design the frameworks yourself, make decisions with data and ship them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organizational design & workforce planning: Design organizational structure, spans, team composition, and headcount plans as we scale, including how AI changes roles, team sizes, and what we hire for.

  • Performance, leveling & talent management: Build consistent leveling and performance frameworks across functions. Oversee performance cycles and calibration, and own talent reviews, succession planning, and the resolution of legacy leveling inconsistencies.

  • Compensation, equity & benefits: Build competitive, internally consistent compensation bands, equity frameworks, and regional benefits. Own compensation benchmarking, offer governance, and compensation cost discipline, with particular attention to US-market competitiveness.

  • Hiring strategy & talent standards: Define hiring priorities, workforce needs, and senior hiring, and set a consistently high talent bar, including AI fluency.

  • High-performer retention & growth: Identify and retain top talent, build meaningful career paths, and own succession and development plans. Monitor regretted attrition and address systemic retention risks.

  • Manager effectiveness: Equip managers to hire, develop, evaluate, and retain strong teams. Set practical management standards and oversee manager development, with clear accountability for performance and people decisions.

  • Culture & organizational health: Maintain a cohesive, high-performance culture across regions and hybrid teams. Identify and address organizational friction, engagement risks, and gaps in accountability or collaboration.

  • People analytics & governance: Define clear People KPIs, review cadence, and decision frameworks. Lead strategic employment-structure decisions, including entity/EOR considerations, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

  • People function leadership: Lead and develop the People team, ensuring strong execution of recruiting, employee lifecycle, employee relations, compliance, and HR operations through the team and appropriate external experts.

Qualifications

  • Experience building People programs in high-growth tech companies, ideally with 8+ years of progressive experience across People Operations, People Strategy, HRBP, or related roles.

  • Proven ability to design and implement People frameworks, in at least two of the following areas: compensation and job leveling, performance management and calibration, talent development, or organizational design.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to use data to diagnose organizational problems, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations that balance employee experience, performance, and financial discipline.

  • A first managerial experience required, having led and developed at least a small People or HR team.

  • Comfort operating hands-on in a lean, fast-moving organization, building practical first versions of processes and systems rather than relying on large teams or extensive external support.

Why ScorePlay?

  • Join at a pivotal moment: the V1s are live and working well, and now we’re building the next version together as we scale fast

  • A global People agenda: teams in Paris, New York and across Europe, with US and European comp, employment and culture questions on your desk.

  • Real influence: you’ll work with the CEO and Head of Ops and bring People expertise into the decisions that shape the company.

  • A high bar: the goal is to have the best possible person in every seat, and you set the standard for what that means.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Marketing Team

Marketing at Pelico is a growth function, not a support function. We work hand-in-hand with Sales and BDRs to create qualified pipeline with the largest industrial companies in the world. Our audience is senior: COOs, VPs of Operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders at enterprise accounts.

Events are one of our strongest levers for reaching them: trade shows, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and Pelico-hosted events in Europe and the US—occasionally co-hosted with partners and industry bodies, which means co-building the format, splitting the cost, and sharing the audience. We measure ourselves on meetings and pipeline, not on badge scans.

Your Mission

You'll own Pelico's event growth engine end-to-end, turning field events into a measurable, efficient source of qualified pipeline and customer engagement.

  • Decide what we do and what we stop: You own the portfolio—which events we commit to, which we drop, and which formats get more budget next year. This is the heart of the role.

  • Own the event portfolio from strategy and prioritization through delivery, follow-up, and post-event review: That covers trade shows, webinars, executive dinners, roundtables, as well as Pelico-hosted, customer, and partner events.

  • Tie every event to a commercial outcome: For each event, you'll define the target accounts and audiences, the meeting and pipeline goals, and the metrics that matter.

  • Run delivery and budget with discipline: You'll set clear timelines, owners, and vendor plans, keeping spend under control across many activities at once.

  • Get Sales and BDRs committed: No event goes ahead without Sales ownership, a prospecting plan, pre-booked meetings, and a named follow-up owner.

  • Make results visible: You'll set up reliable lead capture and HubSpot tracking so leads, meetings, opportunities, and costs can be tracked for every event.

  • Turn events into content: Speaker and customer interviews, event films, social coverage, and approvals with appearing customers—coordinated with team members who produce it.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

As a Forward Software Engineer, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who has shipped agentic or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of agents that work in the demo and fall apart on real tasks: tool calls that fail silently, loops that never end, and quality that drifts after launch. That production depth is your edge. You build across the stack, and you'd rather ship a plain UI on a solid foundation than a polished UI on a fragile one.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. You help set the standard for how the team builds agents that are reliable, observable, and safe to run against sensitive systems.

Security is a big part of where we're heading. If you're drawn to it, that's a strong plus. You might come from security with a real interest in AI engineering, or from AI engineering with a real interest in security. Both paths fit. Curiosity about how systems break, and a habit of learning fast from the people who know the domain, matter. Experience at a security company counts too.


What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the agent architecture: orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval, and the interfaces between agents and the systems they act on.

  • Build across the stack, from backend services and APIs to the interfaces people use to work with agents.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build security into agents from day one: permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, and audit trails for agents that touch sensitive systems.

  • Build the evaluation loop: task-level evals, tracing, and checks that catch agent failures and quality drift before customers do.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.


What We're Looking For

  • You have 5+ years building production software, with at least one agentic or GenAI system shipped to production that you ran after launch.

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have hands-on depth in agent design: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and the ways agents fail in the real world.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

  • You ship in increments and are obsessed with time to value

  • You have product judgment: you learn what users need through customer-facing teams, cut scope hard, and care how the result feels to use.

Ideally you have

  • Open-source contributions, particularly in agents or LLMs.

  • Experience deploying and running what you build: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • A security background in application, cloud, or AI security, such as prompt injection, securing agents, or supply chain (SBOM, SLSA). If that's you, flag it in your application.

  • Experience building for security workflows, such as alert triage, threat hunting, or investigation agents, or with SIEM, XDR, or SOAR tooling.


How We Work in Applied AI

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


[Version française plus bas]


You will be responsible for setting up, programming, and operating CNC lathes to manufacture critical aerospace components, including valve parts, pump components, and shafts.

Working from engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions, you will create and adjust programs directly at the machine, select tooling, prepare setups, and perform turning operations. You will machine materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, titanium, and Inconel, ensuring that parts meet dimensional and surface finish requirements.

The role focuses on hands-on machining and programming at the CNC control. English communication skills are expected for everyday exchanges with our international teams.


Your Responsibilities

  • Create, modify, and optimise CNC turning programs directly at the machine.

  • Set up CNC lathes, including workholding, cutting tools, and tool offsets.

  • Perform turning operations independently, from initial setup through to finished parts.

  • Select suitable cutting tools and machining parameters for each material and operation.

  • Manufacture precision components to drawing specifications, including tight tolerances and surface finish requirements.

  • Perform first-piece and in-process inspections using appropriate measuring equipment.

  • Adjust programs, offsets, and cutting parameters to maintain quality throughout production.

  • Use the band saw to prepare raw material when required.

  • Follow manufacturing instructions and record inspection results to maintain traceability.

  • Carry out first-level maintenance and keep machines and workstations clean and organised.

  • Report machining issues and provide practical feedback to the workshop lead and engineering teams.


Your Profile

  • Vocational or technical qualification in machining, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven experience as a CNC turner, with the ability to set up machines and program directly at the CNC control.

  • Proficiency in ISO/G-code and/or conversational programming.

  • Ability to read engineering drawings and interpret dimensional tolerances, geometric tolerances, and surface finish requirements.

  • Experience machining stainless steel, aluminium, titanium, or nickel-based alloys.

  • Confidence using precision measuring instruments and checking your own work.

  • Experience with driven tooling and Y-axis operations and mill turn would be an advantage.

  • Autonomous, practical, and quality-focused, with careful attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate in English with colleagues from other teams.


Why You’ll Love Working With Us?

  • A hands-on role with responsibility for your parts, from setup and programming through to final inspection.

  • Direct involvement in manufacturing components for next-generation space vehicles and propulsion systems.

  • A modern workshop producing varied and technically challenging parts.

  • Opportunities to develop your machining skills within a growing manufacturing team.

  • A multicultural, international team passionate about space exploration.


////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Vos missions

Vous serez chargé(e) de régler, programmer et conduire des tours à commande numérique pour fabriquer des composants aérospatiaux critiques, notamment des pièces de vannes, des composants de pompes et des arbres.


À partir de plans d’ingénierie et d’instructions de fabrication, vous créerez et ajusterez les programmes directement sur la machine, sélectionnerez l’outillage, préparerez les montages et réaliserez les opérations de tournage. Vous usinerez des matériaux tels que l’acier inoxydable, l’aluminium, le titane et l’Inconel, en veillant à ce que les pièces respectent les exigences dimensionnelles et d’état de surface.


Le poste est centré sur l’usinage et la programmation directement sur la commande numérique. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est attendue pour les échanges quotidiens avec nos équipes internationales.


Vos responsabilités

  • Créer, modifier et optimiser les programmes de tournage CN directement sur la machine.

  • Régler les tours CN, y compris le montage de la pièce, les outils de coupe et les correcteurs d’outils.

  • Réaliser les opérations de tournage de manière autonome, du réglage initial jusqu’à la pièce finie.

  • Choisir les outils de coupe et les paramètres d’usinage adaptés à chaque matériau et à chaque opération.

  • Fabriquer des pièces de précision conformément aux spécifications des plans, y compris des tolérances serrées et des exigences d’état de surface.

  • Effectuer les contrôles de première pièce et en cours de production à l’aide des moyens de mesure appropriés.

  • Ajuster les programmes, les correcteurs et les paramètres de coupe pour maintenir la qualité tout au long de la production.

  • Utiliser la scie à ruban pour préparer la matière brute lorsque nécessaire.

  • Suivre les instructions de fabrication et consigner les résultats de contrôle afin d’assurer la traçabilité.

  • Réaliser la maintenance de premier niveau et maintenir les machines et les postes de travail propres et bien rangés.

  • Signaler les problèmes d’usinage et partager des retours pratiques avec le responsable d’atelier et les équipes d’ingénierie.


Votre profil

  • Formation professionnelle ou technique en usinage, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

  • Expérience avérée en tant que tourneur CN, avec la capacité de régler les machines et de programmer directement sur la commande numérique.

  • Maîtrise de la programmation ISO/code G et/ou de la programmation conversationnelle.

  • Capacité à lire des plans d’ingénierie et à interpréter les tolérances dimensionnelles, les tolérances géométriques et les exigences d’état de surface.

  • Expérience de l’usinage de l’acier inoxydable, de l’aluminium, du titane ou des alliages à base de nickel.

  • Aisance dans l’utilisation d’instruments de mesure de précision et dans le contrôle de son propre travail.

  • Une expérience des outils tournants, des opérations sur axe Y et du tournage-fraisage (mill-turn) serait un atout.

  • Autonome, pragmatique et orienté(e) qualité, avec un grand sens du détail.

  • Capacité à communiquer en anglais avec des collègues d’autres équipes.


Pourquoi vous allez adorer travailler avec nous ?

  • Un poste très opérationnel, avec la responsabilité de vos pièces, du réglage et de la programmation jusqu’au contrôle final.

  • Une implication directe dans la fabrication de composants pour les véhicules spatiaux et les systèmes de propulsion de nouvelle génération.

  • Un atelier moderne produisant des pièces variées et techniquement exigeantes.

  • Des opportunités de développer vos compétences en usinage au sein d’une équipe de fabrication en pleine croissance.

  • Une équipe multiculturelle et internationale, passionnée par l’exploration spatiale.

Why you should join us!

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing the technologies and capabilities needed to make space exploration more accessible. We are looking for a Welding Specialist Engineer to support the industrialization and production readiness of our next-generation thruster hardware, including EBW activities, orbital welding and laser-welded components for a high-thrust engine.

This is an intermediate-level engineering role, working closely with and under the technical guidance of our Senior Welding Specialist Engineer. You will support electron beam welding (EBW) for our new thruster, laser-welding activities for a high-thrust engine and participate on the manufacturing of the orbital welding for the our Nyx capsule propulsion.

You will bring practical knowledge and you will work with design, manufacturing, quality and production teams to turn robust welding requirements into repeatable, well-documented manufacturing processes.

  • Support orbital welding activities (being a qualified welder and support non conformance management).
